text.m01: [softly] …Welcome. [whispers] Welcome to Mint, the ear salon.
text.m02: [softly] Tonight's guest is… Mimi-kun. [whispers] …Which means, you, in front of the screen.
text.m03: [whispers] …Which ear shall I start on? Tell me in the chat.
text.m04: [whispers] …Okay. I'll touch this ear. I warmed my hands first.
text.m05: [whispers] …Squish, squish. [giggles softly] …Heh, so soft. [whispers] …Let yourself relax.
text.m06t: [softly] …Thank you for your order. Steamed towels, on both ears. [sighs contentedly] …Mm, warm, isn't it.
text.m06s: [softly] …Thank you for your order. A spoon I chilled. [whispers] …Tap. [giggles softly] …Did you jump?
text.m07: [whispers] …Next, ear cleaning. …Stay still for just a bit.
text.m08x: [whispers] …Ah, you moved. …It's not safe, so stay still a little longer?
text.m09w: [whispers] …I'll leave a warm stone by your ear. …Slowly warming.
text.m09m: [whispers] …I put on mint lip balm. …Here it comes. [blows softly] …Fuuu. [whispers] …Tingly, right?
text.m10: [whispers] …I have to do the other side too. …Can you roll over?
text.m11: [whispers] …This ear too, just like before. …Squish, squish. Scritch, scritch.
text.m12: [whispers] …Psst. A cool mist, to finish. [softly] …All done.
text.m13: [softly] …So many comments. "I'm getting sleepy"… [giggles softly] heh, good.
text.m14a: [whispers] …A secret. …I actually opened this salon for you.
text.m15: [whispers] …I'll put a blanket on you. …Last of all, say goodnight?
text.m16: [whispers] …Goodnight. …I'll be waiting for your next visit.
text.m17b: [surprised, softly] …Huh, an extension…? [giggles softly] …Heh, can't be helped. [whispers] …Then I'll stay here until you fall asleep.
